density.image_score: number of valid GT boxes in the image

overlap.object_score: maximum intersection area divided by the object's own box area over all other GT boxes in the same image
overlap.image_score: mean object score; zero for images containing zero or one GT object
overlap.threshold_rule: median if positive; otherwise positive 75th percentile; otherwise zero-versus-positive

evaluation.gt_policy: retain every GT object in each selected image; object-level deletion is forbidden
evaluation.evaluator: the same faster-coco-eval COCO bbox evaluator used by the formal release
evaluation.pairing: B0 and Full with the same detector seed
evaluation.summary: three-seed mean and sample standard deviation; deltas are paired within seed

claim_boundary: The analysis describes condition-specific behavior of the full system. It does not identify a causal contribution of UFD, LCCT, QCCR, or UMR in isolation.
